videos.description: The Crew is joined by Matt Kreifelf this week, as he celebrates his 50th birthday in The Bahamas with everyone.

videos.title: Hooked on Travel
videos.description: The Barotse floodplains have a reputation for Tigers that exceed the legendary 20-pound mark. Tommo and Rhu fly into this angling haven hoping to hook into the 'Barotse Express' and in the process discover an equally impressive fish that few have...

videos.title: Reel Africa
videos.description: The tropical waters of Mozambique are home to many strange, beautiful, and sometimes, scary fish species.

videos.title: Inside Angling
videos.description: Inside Angling visits Situ Island found in the Mozambican waters, to tackle those sought after blue-water game fish. Craig Thomassen and his partner end up catching a variety of tropical game fish, enjoying every fight to the fullest.

videos.title: Wildfly Best of
videos.description: Once a year, a phenomenon that is unique to the isle of Goelettes can be witnessed. A fish that can see in panorama is a formidable threat to feeding birds and watching them attack a flying meal is unbelievable.

videos.title: Wild Fish Wild Places
videos.description: Denis Isbister joins Austin Lindsey and young Rylan Lambert in North Dakota for a tougher-than-expected hunt for giant walleye.

videos.title: Gone Again With Carter Andrews
videos.description: Carter Andrews travels to Québec, Canada, for an unforgettable adventure fishing Atlantic salmon on the legendary Cascapédia River and striped bass in Québec waters while discovering local destinations and meeting locals who share the culture, history, and natural beauty that make the region special.

videos.title: Hooked on Africa Best of
videos.description: Craig is hunting down the ultimate estuarine predator, the elusive River Snapper. The protected waters of the St Lucia section of the Isimangaliso Wetland Park is a renowned destination for this dirty fighter but it will take all of Craig's cunning.
